contract.source: Existing Server addresses.controller.ts, addresses.service.ts and create/update shipping address DTOs; no backend changes
contract.authentication: Private Bearer from existing auth runtime; no user ID or credential exposed to the React tree
contract.response: Flat complete array of public addresses, including empty array
contract.defaultRules: First address becomes principal; selecting another clears the former principal; deleting principal can promote a remaining address. Backend ignores isDefault:false when updating.
contract.selectionScope: Principal address in the account; checkout and order selection remain separate activities

architecture.flow: ShippingAddressesScreen -> useShippingAddressesViewModel -> shared controller -> shippingAddressActions -> ShippingAddressRepository -> ApiShippingAddressRepository -> HttpClient
architecture.bootstrap: Lazy authenticated composition in createApplicationRuntime; existing authorizationSession isolates account changes from public profile metadata updates
architecture.draftPersistence: Memory only, cleared on Cancel or session boundary
architecture.recovery: Failed reads and uncertain mutations retain confirmed rows and draft, block writes and require an explicit successful GET; no automatic write retry
architecture.defaultReconciliation: GET may force draft.isDefault to true for an address already confirmed principal while preserving all eleven text fields
architecture.session: Logout, changed account and new login to the same account clear private rows/draft and invalidate late responses; 401 clears data and blocks retries until new authentication

automatedChecks.independentBoundedReview: Reviewed API mapping, auth/session boundaries, controller and UI. Corrected principal reconciliation after GET, blocked writes after failed GET and disabled create save when a refresh reaches five addresses. No unresolved actionable findings from that bounded review.

httpIntegration.apiAndTokenStore: Simulated in isolated ephemeral loopback server and memory; no real account or backend mutations
coverage: Authenticated GET, POST, PATCH, principal selection and DELETE through real HttpClient/Repository/actions/controller/AuthSession
Full authoritative collections, optional-field omission and clearing, normalized allowlisted payloads
Bearer authentication with no cookies or user identifier in request bodies
PATCH committed before response loss: no optimistic publish, previous rows and draft retained, explicit GET reconciles without repeating PATCH
Synchronous logout cleanup, account isolation and 401 block until new login
In-flight transport cancellation for all five actions with no duplicate request
